description: Boundary cases of the AI Additions connection URL rule (#834). A base_url or keycloak_public_url is valid when, after trimming surrounding whitespace, it matches ^https?://([^/?#@\\\s]+)(/[^?#\\\s]*)?$ (case-insensitive), has no . or .. path segment, is at most 2048 characters long and parses as a URL with a non-empty host. normalized is the value the management console stores: trimmed, without trailing slashes. ethicapp (isValidAiAdditionsUrl) and the management console (normalizeConnectionUrl) must both pass every case; the console keeps a byte-identical copy of this file.

cases.name: http
cases.reason: http is allowed, for internal networks.

cases.name: https
cases.reason: https is allowed.

cases.name: uppercase scheme and host
cases.reason: The scheme is case-insensitive; the value is kept as typed.

cases.name: mixed-case scheme
cases.reason: The scheme is case-insensitive.

cases.name: host with port
cases.reason: An explicit port is part of the authority.

cases.name: highest port
cases.reason: 65535 is a valid port.

cases.name: IPv4 literal with a path prefix
cases.reason: IP literals are hosts.

cases.name: IPv6 literal with port
cases.reason: Bracketed IPv6 literals are hosts.

cases.name: IPv6 literal
cases.reason: Bracketed IPv6 literals are hosts.

cases.name: Docker-internal name
cases.reason: Single-label service names are hosts.

cases.name: path prefix
cases.reason: A path prefix is allowed; derived paths are appended to it.

cases.name: nested path prefix
cases.reason: A path prefix may have several segments.

cases.name: trailing slash
cases.reason: Trailing slashes are accepted and dropped.

cases.name: several trailing slashes after a path
cases.reason: Trailing slashes are accepted and dropped.

cases.name: segments that contain dots among other characters
cases.reason: Only segments that are exactly . or .. are dot segments.

cases.name: @ in the path
cases.reason: An @ after the authority is not userinfo.

cases.name: spaces around
cases.reason: Surrounding whitespace is trimmed.

cases.name: tab and newline around
cases.reason: Surrounding whitespace is trimmed.

cases.name: 2048 characters
cases.reason: 2048 characters is the maximum length.

cases.name: port 65536
cases.reason: The port is out of range, so the URL does not parse.

cases.name: non-numeric port
cases.reason: The port is not a number, so the URL does not parse.

cases.name: port without a host
cases.reason: The authority has no host.

cases.name: query string
cases.reason: A query would move the derived paths into the query.

cases.name: query after a path
cases.reason: A query would move the derived paths into the query.

cases.name: empty query
cases.reason: An empty query is still a query.

cases.name: fragment
cases.reason: A fragment would hide the derived paths.

cases.name: fragment after a path
cases.reason: A fragment would hide the derived paths.

cases.name: empty fragment
cases.reason: An empty fragment is still a fragment.

cases.name: user name
cases.reason: Userinfo is not allowed.

cases.name: user name and password
cases.reason: Userinfo is not allowed.

cases.name: password only
cases.reason: Userinfo is not allowed.

cases.name: empty userinfo
cases.reason: Userinfo is not allowed, even empty.

cases.name: backslash in the authority
cases.reason: Parsers disagree on backslashes.

cases.name: backslash in the path
cases.reason: Parsers disagree on backslashes.

cases.name: space in the host
cases.reason: Whitespace inside the URL is not allowed.

cases.name: space in the path
cases.reason: Whitespace inside the URL is not allowed.

cases.name: tab in the path
cases.reason: Whitespace inside the URL is not allowed.

cases.name: dot segment
cases.reason: URL parsers resolve dot segments, string concatenation does not.

cases.name: dot-dot segment
cases.reason: URL parsers resolve dot segments, string concatenation does not.

cases.name: trailing dot segment
cases.reason: Dot segments are not allowed.

cases.name: trailing dot-dot segment
cases.reason: Dot segments are not allowed.

cases.name: scheme without slashes
cases.reason: The WHATWG parser repairs it, string concatenation does not.

cases.name: scheme with one slash
cases.reason: The WHATWG parser repairs it, string concatenation does not.

cases.name: empty authority
cases.reason: The authority is empty.

cases.name: scheme only
cases.reason: There is no authority.

cases.name: another scheme
cases.reason: Only http and https are allowed.

cases.name: file scheme
cases.reason: Only http and https are allowed.

cases.name: no scheme
cases.reason: The scheme is required.

cases.name: scheme-relative
cases.reason: The scheme is required.

cases.name: 2049 characters
cases.reason: Longer than 2048 characters.

cases.name: empty string
cases.reason: A value is required.

cases.name: whitespace only
cases.reason: A value is required.

cases.name: null
cases.reason: Not a string.

cases.name: number
cases.reason: Not a string.
